entry.title: Primeros Nicaragua Maduro — Tin of 6
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Quick premium smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, roasted coffee, earth, leather, caramel sweetness and black pepper give the Nicaragua Maduro a darker, more forceful Primeros profile. The Mexican Sumatra Maduro wrapper should deepen the cocoa and sweetness while the Nicaraguan-Dominican core keeps the smoke earthy and spicy, with coffee and leather carrying into a peppery finish.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Exact single taster available from The Index for A$24.10.
